newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - INDEX PUSHES TO NEW RECORD.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - INDEX PUSHES TO NEW RECORD.

text.p: upward tend, with another increase in the domestic index from
its all-time record of 407.29 to 407.59 points.
On the domestic board Barclays put on 25 thebe and
was well bid at 650/675. Investment company Kgola ya Sechaba
added five to trade at 180. Standard Chartered
rose 15 to 565t. Brewery holding company Sechaba shed
10, trading at 280/281, as it went ex dividend.
Trading unchanged were Botswana Insurance , First
National and variable loan stock company RDC
Untraded were oil company Engen 445/475, security
group Inco 80/85, food and tobacco wholesaler Metsef
bid only at 645 and milling company and food wholesaler
On the foreign board De Beers , trading 300 shares,
firmed to 13,138. Undervalued Assets Africa Fund Regent
